reviews.title: Highly Disappointed
reviews.text:
I used Dotloop hoping for a streamlined, honest and reliable transaction-management solution. Instead, what I got was a platform rife with misleading promises and frustrating shortcomings.
	•	Glitches and Data Loss — Numerous users report that Dotloop “wipes out what you do when you type,” or otherwise loses data mid-document, which can completely derail a transaction.  ￼
	•	Poor Mobile & Document Handling Experience — The mobile version is often cited as clunky and painful to use: setting up documents on the go “isn’t worth the time,” and many agents find that the app’s glitches make mobile document management unreliable.  ￼
	•	Privacy & Ownership Concerns — Because Dotloop is owned by Zillow, several agents worry about data sharing: by using Dotloop, you may inadvertently be giving Zillow access to your contacts, leads, and internal transaction data — effectively “paying Zillow to profit from YOUR leads.” One user summed it up:

“Using Dotloop … you’re literally PAYING Zillow to profit from YOUR leads.”  ￼

	•	Hidden Costs & Pressure to Upgrade — While Dotloop is pitched as affordable, many users report concerns about pricing transparency, locked-feature paywalls, and additional costs that weren’t clearly communicated upfront.  ￼
